interpretation: ACS 2020-2024 pooled survey estimate in 2024 inflation-adjusted USD; not a single-year 2024 income measurement. Census B19013 published margin of error is a 90-percent survey MOE, not a standard deviation or a newly computed confidence interval. Unavailable and suppressed values remain null, never zero. State medians are not additive or household-weighted.
method: Source: official Census 2024 ACS five-year table-based Summary File B19013; select only original 0400000USxx publisher geographies. Preserve the GEO_ID, B19013_E001 estimate and B19013_M001 margin of error, equivalent to API B19013_001E/B19013_001M. No summing state medians, recalculating uncertainty, or imputation. Reference period 2020-2024, inflation-adjusted 2024 USD.
